name: Mam nhum
summary: Sea-urchin meat fermented into a salty, sour, strongly fragrant mắm. Eat it with rice noodles, boiled meat, or hot rice.
taste: Salty, sour, and strongly fragrant, and also sweet-smelling and rich.
howToEat: Use it as a condiment with rice noodles, boiled meat, and hot rice rather than eating it on its own.
Buy a jar at the daily market to take home.
where: Chợ Côn Đảo, the daily market in town.
seoTitle: Mam nhum — sea-urchin ferment in Con Dao
seoDescription: Mắm nhum is fermented sea-urchin meat from Côn Đảo, salty, sour, and strongly fragrant, eaten with rice noodles, boiled meat, and hot rice.
